# Function to calculate and plot variable importance
plot_importance <- function(formula, data) {
  
  # Extract coefficients, sort by absolute value, convert to data frame
  item_nbr<-unique(data$item_nbr)
  model <- lm(formula,data = data)
  coefs <- data.frame(Feature = names(coef(model)[-1]),
                      Coefficient = coef(model)[-1])
  coefs$Feature <- reorder(coefs$Feature, abs(coefs$Coefficient))
  
  
  plot(ggplot(coefs, aes(x = Feature, y = Coefficient)) +
         geom_col() +
         coord_flip() + 
         labs(title = paste("Feature Importance (Standardized Coefficients) Item Number " , toString(item_nbr))) +
         theme_minimal())
}

#Tune and Evaluate Models for Effectiveness
run_evaluate <- function(modelType,item_nbr,training_set,test_set,validation_set){
  
  train_df <- training_set[complete.cases(training_set),]
  train_df$is_weekend <- as.numeric(train_df$is_weekend)
  train_df$is_rainy_day <- as.numeric(train_df$is_rainy_day)
  test_df <- test_set[complete.cases(test_set),]
  test_df$is_weekend <- as.numeric(test_df$is_weekend)
  test_df$is_rainy_day <- as.numeric(test_df$is_rainy_day)
  validation_df <- validation_set[complete.cases(validation_set),]
  validation_df$is_weekend <- as.numeric(validation_df$is_weekend)
  validation_df$is_rainy_day <- as.numeric(validation_df$is_rainy_day)
  model <- NULL
  if(modelType == "Linear Regression"){
    
    train_full <- rbind(train_df, validation_df)
    model <- lm(units~tavg+depart+wetbulb+dewpoint+heat+cool+sunrise+sunset+snowfall+preciptotal+stnpressure+sealevel+resultspeed+resultdir+avgspeed+is_weekend+is_rainy_day,data=train_full)
  }else if(modelType == "Linear Regression Ridge"){
    
    # Prepare glmnet input as matrix of predictors and response var as vector
    X <- model.matrix(units~tavg+depart+wetbulb+dewpoint+heat+cool+sunrise+sunset+snowfall+preciptotal+stnpressure+sealevel+resultspeed+resultdir+avgspeed+is_weekend+is_rainy_day, data=train_df)
    test_df <- model.matrix(units~tavg+depart+wetbulb+dewpoint+heat+cool+sunrise+sunset+snowfall+preciptotal+stnpressure+sealevel+resultspeed+resultdir+avgspeed+is_weekend+is_rainy_day, data=test_df)
    val_df <- model.matrix(units~tavg+depart+wetbulb+dewpoint+heat+cool+sunrise+sunset+snowfall+preciptotal+stnpressure+sealevel+resultspeed+resultdir+avgspeed+is_weekend+is_rainy_day, data=validation_df)
    response <- training_set$units
    # alpha=0 means ridge regression. 
    ridge_model <- glmnet(X, response, alpha=0)
    lambdas <- ridge_model$lambda
    val_errors <- c()
    for (l in lambdas) {
      preds <- predict(ridge_model, s = l, newx =val_df)
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((validation_df$units - preds)^2))
      val_errors <- c(val_errors, rmse)
    }
    best_lambda <- lambdas[which.min(val_errors)]
    train_full <- rbind(train_df, validation_df)
    # Fit final model, get its RMSE and multiple R-squared
    x_full <- model.matrix(units~tavg+depart+wetbulb+dewpoint+heat+cool+sunrise+sunset+snowfall+preciptotal+stnpressure+sealevel+resultspeed+resultdir+avgspeed+is_weekend+is_rainy_day, data=train_full)
    y_full <- train_full$units
    model <- glmnet(x_full, y_full, alpha = 0, lambda = best_lambda)
    ridge_coefs <- coef(model, s = best_lambda)
    ridge_coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(ridge_coefs))
    ridge_coef_df$Feature <- rownames(ridge_coef_df)
    colnames(ridge_coef_df)[1] <- 'Coefficient'
    print(ridge_coef_df)
  }else{
    
    cp_values <- seq(0.001, 0.05, by = 0.005)
    val_rmse <- c()
    for (cp in cp_values) {
      dtmodel <- rpart(units~tavg+depart+dewpoint+wetbulb+heat+cool+sunrise+sunset+snowfall+preciptotal+stnpressure+sealevel+resultspeed+resultdir+avgspeed+is_weekend+is_rainy_day, method = "anova", data = train_df)
      preds <- predict(dtmodel, newdata = validation_df)
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((validation_df$units - preds)^2))
      val_rmse <- c(val_rmse, rmse)
    }
    best_cp <- cp_values[which.min(val_rmse)]
    train_full <- rbind(train_df, validation_df)
    model <- rpart(units~tavg+depart+dewpoint+wetbulb+heat+cool+sunrise+sunset+snowfall+preciptotal+stnpressure+sealevel+resultspeed+resultdir+avgspeed+is_weekend+is_rainy_day, method = "anova", data = train_full,control = rpart.control(cp = best_cp),maxdepth = 10)
  feature_importance <- varImp(model)
  print(arrange(feature_importance, desc(Overall)))
  pdf(sprintf("tree%d.pdf",item_nbr), width = 14, height = 10)
  rpart.plot(model)
  dev.off()
  }
  print(summary(model))
  predictions <- predict(model,test_df)
  if(modelType == "Linear Regression Ridge"){
    df <- as.data.frame(test_set[complete.cases(test_set),])
    print(sprintf("%s RMSE for Item Number %d:%f" ,modelType,item_nbr,RMSE(predictions, df$units)))
    print(sprintf("%s MAE for Item Number %d:%f",modelType,item_nbr, mean(abs(predictions -df$units))))
    print(sprintf("%s R-squared for Item Number %d:%f",modelType,item_nbr,R2(predictions,df$units)))
  }else{
    print(sprintf("%s RMSE for Item Number %d:%f" ,modelType,item_nbr,RMSE(predictions, test_df$units)))
    print(sprintf("%s MAE for Item Number %d:%f",modelType,item_nbr, mean(abs(predictions - test_df$units))))
    print(sprintf("%s R-squared for Item Number %d:%f",modelType,item_nbr,R2(predictions,test_df$units)))
  }
  
  
}

#Evaluate 3 selected Models
models_run_evaluate <- function(data){
  
  df <- data.frame(data)
  item_nbr<-unique(df$item_nbr)
  df$is_weekend <- lubridate::wday(df$date,week_start = 1)>= 6
  df$is_rainy_day <- grepl("RA|TS|GR|SH|DZ", df$codesum, ignore.case = TRUE)
  Q1 <- quantile(df$units, .25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(df$units, .75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr = Q3 - Q1
  # 2. Define the bounds
  lower_bound <- Q1 - (iqr * 1.5)
  upper_bound <- Q3 +  (iqr * 1.5) 
  # 3. Subset the data to include only values within the bounds
  df <- subset(df, df$units >= lower_bound & df$units <= upper_bound)
  set.seed(123)
  # Input 2. Set the fractions of the dataframe you want to split into training, 
  # validation, and test.
  fractionTraining   <- 0.60
  fractionValidation <- 0.20
  fractionTest       <- 0.20
  
  # Compute sample sizes.
  sampleSizeTraining   <- floor(fractionTraining   * nrow(df))
  sampleSizeValidation <- floor(fractionValidation * nrow(df))
  sampleSizeTest       <- floor(fractionTest       * nrow(df))
  
  # Create the randomly-sampled indices for the dataframe. Use setdiff() to
  # avoid overlapping subsets of indices.
  indicesTraining    <- sort(sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), size=sampleSizeTraining))
  indicesNotTraining <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), indicesTraining)
  indicesValidation  <- sort(sample(indicesNotTraining, size=sampleSizeValidation))
  indicesTest        <- setdiff(indicesNotTraining, indicesValidation)
  
  # Finally, output the three dataframes for training, validation and test.
  train_set <- df[indicesTraining, ]
  validation_set <- df[indicesValidation, ]
  test_set <- df[indicesTest, ]
  
  #Linear Regression
  run_evaluate("Linear Regression",item_nbr,train_set,test_set,validation_set)
  #Linear Regression Ridge
  run_evaluate("Linear Regression Ridge",item_nbr,train_set,test_set,validation_set)
  #Decision Trees
  run_evaluate("Decision Trees",item_nbr,train_set,test_set,validation_set)
  showVisualizations(df)
  return("Zero")
  
}

#Calculate the missing data and replace it in dataframe
imputeMissingData <- function(data){
  
  tmax_data <- data[['tmax']]
  tmax_data[is.na(tmax_data)] <- mean(tmax_data[!is.na(tmax_data)])
  data$tmax <- tmax_data
  tmin_data <- data[['tmin']]
  tmin_data[is.na(tmin_data)] <- mean(tmin_data[!is.na(tmin_data)])
  data$tmin <- tmin_data
  depart_data <- data[['depart']]
  depart_data[is.na(depart_data)] <- mean(depart_data[!is.na(depart_data)])
  data$depart <- depart_data
  dewpoint_data <- data[['dewpoint']]
  dewpoint_data[is.na(dewpoint_data)] <- mean(dewpoint_data[!is.na(dewpoint_data)])
  data$dewpoint <- dewpoint_data
  wetbulb_data <- data[['wetbulb']]
  wetbulb_data[is.na(wetbulb_data)] <- mean(wetbulb_data[!is.na(wetbulb_data)])
  data$wetbulb <- wetbulb_data
  heat_data <- data[['heat']]
  data$heat <- nocb(heat_data)
  cool_data <- data[['cool']]
  data$cool <- nocb(cool_data)
  sunrise_data <- data[['sunrise']]
  data$sunrise <- locf(sunrise_data)
  data$sunrise <- nocb(sunrise_data)
  data$sunrise <- forbak(sunrise_data)
  data$sunrise_format <- as.POSIXct(data$sunrise, format = "%H:%M:%S")
  data$sunrise <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(data$sunrise,format = "%H:%M:%S"))
  sunset_data <- data[['sunset']]
  data$sunset <- locf(sunset_data)
  data$sunset <- nocb(sunset_data)
  data$sunset <- forbak(sunset_data)
  data$sunset_format <- as.POSIXct(data$sunset, format = "%H:%M:%S")
  data$sunset <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(data$sunset,format = "%H:%M:%S"))
  stnpressure_data <- data[['stnpressure']]
  stnpressure_data[is.na(stnpressure_data)] <- mean(stnpressure_data[!is.na(stnpressure_data)])
  data$stnpressure <- stnpressure_data
  sealevel_data <- data[['sealevel']]
  sealevel_data[is.na(sealevel_data)] <- mean(sealevel_data[!is.na(sealevel_data)])
  data$sealevel <- sealevel_data
  resultspeed_data <- data[['resultspeed']]
  data$resultspeed <- nocb(resultspeed_data)
  resultdir_data <- data[['resultdir']]
  data$resultdir <- nocb(resultdir_data)
  avgspeed_data <- data[['avgspeed']]
  data$avgspeed <- nocb(avgspeed_data)
  snowfall_data <- data[['snowfall']]
  snowfall_data[is.na(snowfall_data)] <- mean(snowfall_data[!is.na(snowfall_data)])
  data$snowfall <- snowfall_data
  preciptotal_data <- data[['preciptotal']]
  data$preciptotal <- nocb(preciptotal_data)
  tavg_data <- data[['tavg']]
  tavg_data[is.na(tavg_data)] <- mean(tavg_data[!is.na(tavg_data)])
  data$tavg <- tavg_data
  units_data <- data[['units']]
  units_data[is.na(units_data)] <- nocb(units_data)
  data$units <- units_data
  data$tavg <- replace(tavg_data, toupper(as.character(tavg_data)) == 'T', as.numeric(mean(tavg_data[!is.na(tavg_data)])))
  data$snowfall <- as.character(data$snowfall)
  data$snowfall[toupper(data$snowfall) == 'T'] <- '0.001'
  data$snowfall <- as.numeric(data$snowfall)

  data$preciptotal <- as.character(data$preciptotal)
  data$preciptotal[toupper(data$preciptotal) == 'T'] <- '0.001'
  data$preciptotal <- as.numeric(data$preciptotal)
  return (data)
  
}
